$comment: Integration manifest for tools that run next to this plugin (first consumer: agent-router's first-principles integration). It states this plugin's public identity so a consumer reads it instead of hard-coding it. Data only: no consumer is required, and nothing in this plugin reads this file. Canonical source: shared/spine/references/integration.json, emitted verbatim to first-principles/references/integration.json by scripts/sync-content.py --write. Evolution is add-only: adding a key keeps manifest_version; removing or renaming a key, or changing a value's meaning, increments it. Paths are relative to the plugin root.
